text:
miguel: FYI discovered during SI staging: vendor manifest firmware is v1.2.3 but our rack validator expects v1.2.4. This blocks the DC swap scheduled for tomorrow.
priya: Damn. How many racks/nodes affected and which SKU? Any immediate customer impact? @ava can you share specifics? :eyes: 
ava: Affected: 4 racks (32 nodes) of sku MARKET-RTX-A1. Staging reported 2 nodes with bootloop traces. Manifest snippet from partner attached below.
miguel: Partner manifest:
```
sku: MARKET-RTX-A1
qty: 32
fw_version: 1.2.3
serials: [redacted]
```
ops-bot: vendor-inventory-bot placed hold: hold-7382 on MARKET-RTX-A1 due to firmware_mismatch.
chris: Technical options: 1) hotflash at DC with vendor-signed image + vendor engineer onsite (warranty), ~2hr per rack; 2) partial swap to validate two racks then continue; 3) reroute customers to marketplace burst pools. Hotflash requires signed binary/approval.
orion-si: Vendor refused remote flashing for warranty reasons. We can validate by swapping 2 racks into staging first, but that'll push timeline by ~48h. We've captured logs and won't proceed until vendor confirms.
vendor-pm: Partner here. Confirmed we shipped v1.2.3 by mistake from factory batch. Regional stock: 8 nodes available immediately, we can overnight 24 nodes with v1.2.4 if you cover expedited freight. Otherwise onsite engineer can hotflash but warranty only with paid tech onsite.
lydia: Sales flags two Dedicated customers with onboarding starting Monday. If swap slips 48h, we'll miss onboarding SLA for one customer. Need quick contingency that preserves SLAs.
priya: Triage options (ranked):
- Accept 8 regional nodes now, overnight 24 nodes at expedited freight (24h) + marketplace burst for residual (fastest customer mitigation)
- Approve paid vendor engineer for hotflash on-site (10k USD quote) to avoid long ship times
- Shift reserved capacity from another region (introduces latency/SLA tradeoffs)
who can check marketplace burst quota and billing approval?
chris: Marketplace bursting can be enabled within 6hrs from a technical standpoint but needs billing sign-off for the cost delta (~$48k estimate for expected token consumption). I can prepare uplift request.
ava: I've pulled logs and uploaded to SI share: https://files.example/si/logs/hold-7382 (vendor access pending). Orion, can you keep the two suspect racks isolated?
orion-si: Holding two racks offline for diagnostics. Will not proceed without partner acknowledgement.
priya: @vendor-pm can you confirm ETA for shipping 24 nodes if we pay expedited? Also confirm the 8 regional nodes availability window (are those reserved elsewhere?).
vendor-pm: 8 nodes are available with same-day pickup; 24 nodes ship overnight if you commit by 18:00 PT and accept expedited fees. Availability valid for 24h hold.
miguel: Plan proposal for decision call in 15m: accept 8 nodes immediately, enable marketplace burst for customers (stand up in ~6hrs), approve overnight 24 nodes if finance ok with expedited fees, and contingency for paid vendor engineer for the two racks if needed.
lydia: I'll draft customer comms: say we have temporary routing to marketplace while validating physical racks, ETA for full move updated. Will push to customers after decision.
priya: I'll create a post-incident doc template and include hold-7382 and vendor contact. Also escalating to partner PM if shipping commitment slips.
chris: I'll start billing approval flow now and loop finance. Expect reply in ~2hrs.
ava: Noted. Keeping SI on hold and will update logs with vendor access once they confirm.
miguel: Thanks everyone. Decision call in 15. If partner misses the 18:00 cutoff, we move to paid vendor engineer + marketplace burst.
